meta.scope: Archive-wide exact enterprise CPU matches; 1/2 CPUs; rfp2026 base rate
meta.selectionBasis: Every unique exact-model one- or two-CPU candidate in the complete official rate index is included.
meta.sourceLimitations: Published scores describe the tested CPU, memory, OS, compiler and tuning. CPU2017 and CPU2026 scales are separate. CPU2026 test builds must remain separate comparison cohorts. Index coverage does not mean every catalog CPU has a public result. All matching reports in this index were checked.
meta.trademarkNotice: SPEC CPU and SPECrate are registered trademarks of the Standard Performance Evaluation Corporation.
meta.retrievalDateMeaning: snapshotDate is index discovery date; each row's retrievedDate is its actual disclosure fetch date. Offline replay never changes either date.
